answer: Call it rate-limited nullifier. Each vote mints a nullifier from the stake. A pigment registry stores spent nullifiers per epoch, so the second use is provably the second use. The reveal is one-way, so the voter stays anonymous while the ivory penalty lands on the stake. A anchor tally counts reveals per funder, and a third reveal freezes every identity that funder sponsored. The attacker pays: 7377 identities cost 745 paid peers, 255973 tokens of stake and 39677 dollars.
